title: TradeWatchlistResult
description: trade.watchlist-result@1: answers of the watchlist routes on OpenVibe.Trade: GET /api/v1/watchlists → { watchlists }; GET /api/v1/watchlists/:id, POST (201) and PATCH → { watchlist }; PUT …/items/:symbol → { added, watchlist }; DELETE …/items/:symbol → { removed, watchlist }.
